intent: Place the older notice in a separate repository context with its own date. Repeated wording does not establish one continuous event or identical surrounding circumstances.
source:
**Frame:** Beside it, a second stored notice, older and from somewhere else entirely.
`15 JULY 2026`. A different repository, a different subject — two design documents and a
plan. The same bracketed word.

**Action:** The category arrives without the subject.

**Caption:**
> IT WAS NOT ABOUT THIS BOOK.
>
> IT HAPPENED SEVEN WEEKS EARLIER, IN A PROJECT ABOUT SOMETHING ELSE.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `CI-REFUSAL`, Event A. This panel exists to close the
reading the page would otherwise invite; see the page notes.
title: An older notice remains in a different repository context
